chunks: Al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad al-Jawharī narrated from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah, who said:
I read in a man's letter to Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام: A man married a woman in mutʿah for a specified term, so when the term between them ended, is it permissible for him to marry her sister?
He said: It is not permissible for him until her waiting period has ended.

key_terms.أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى: a specified fixed period set in the marriage contract
key_terms.بِأُخْتِهَا: her sister, whose marriage is being asked about
key_terms.عِدَّتُهَا: her waiting period after the end of the marriage
key_terms.مُتْعَةً: temporary marriage contracted for a fixed term

ai.seo_question: Can a man marry the sister of a woman from a mutʿah marriage immediately after the term ends?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning mutʿah and kinship-related marriage restrictions. It states that after the fixed term ends, a man may not marry the woman's sister until the woman's ʿiddah has fully concluded.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.4603 - Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad al-Jawhari narrated from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah:
I read in a man's letter to Abu al-Hasan (as) about a man who married a woman in Mut'ah (temporary marriage) for a specified period. When the term between them ended, he asked whether it was permissible for him to marry her sister.
Imam (as) replied: "It is not permissible for him until her waiting period ('iddah) has ended."
